import time
import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Solver
from pysat.card import CardEnc

start = time.time()
n = 14
girth = 7

solver = Solver(name='glucose4')

def E(i, j):
    if i > j:
        i, j = j, i
    return i * n - i * (i + 1) // 2 + j - i

num_edges = n * (n - 1) // 2

clauses = 0
for length in range(3, girth):
    for cycle in itertools.combinations(range(n), length):
        for p in itertools.permutations(cycle):
            if p[0] == min(p) and p[1] < p[-1]:
                clause = []
                for k in range(length):
                    clause.append(-E(p[k], p[(k+1)%length]))
                solver.add_clause(clause)
                clauses += 1

print(f"Generated {clauses} clauses in {time.time() - start:.2f}s")

edge_vars = [E(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)]
cnf = CardEnc.atleast(lits=edge_vars, bound=19, top_id=num_edges)
for clause in cnf.clauses:
    solver.add_clause(clause)

print(f"Added cardinality constraints in {time.time() - start:.2f}s")

print("Solving...")
if solver.solve():
    print("SAT")
else:
    print("UNSAT")
print(f"Total time: {time.time() - start:.2f}s")
